# `aitbc config check-keys`

Check which environment API keys are configured and required.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc config check-keys [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--strict` | flag | `false` | no | Exit with error if any required key is missing |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc config check-keys
```
